subject.title: [Feature]: Pattern-based channel allowlist for Discord (glob/wildcard support)

question: Should Discord guild channel allowlists support name patterns, and what precedence should they have relative to exact id/name/slug matches, thread-parent matches, and literal `*`?
rationale: This choice establishes a public access-control contract and determines whether a pattern may broaden or override existing channel authorization; implementation mechanics cannot safely decide it.

options.title: Add constrained patterns
options.body: Support a documented wildcard subset after exact and parent matches but before literal `*`, with validation, diagnostics, and authorization regression coverage.

options.title: Use categories only
options.body: Decline name patterns and make category inheritance the supported mechanism for dynamically created channel groups.

options.title: Retain exact matching
options.body: Keep exact entries and literal `*` only, relying on per-channel updates or separate runtime reload tooling.

recommendation.title: Add constrained patterns
recommendation.body: Support a documented wildcard subset after exact and parent matches but before literal `*`, with validation, diagnostics, and authorization regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared matcher and recent Discord allowlist history make this the strongest available owner for the precedence decision.
